datasetContainmentContract.spatialRule: target bbox must be contained by evidence applicability bbox; CRS identifiers must match exactly before comparison
datasetContainmentContract.temporalRule: target inclusive year interval must be contained by evidence inclusive applicability interval
datasetContainmentContract.regionalRule: dataset parentRegionScope and regionalProfileId must match the request
datasetContainmentContract.parameterRule: every consumed parameter must be listed in parameterNames
datasetContainmentContract.provenanceRule: datasetId and at least one sourceId are mandatory
datasetContainmentContract.failurePolicy: Reject unresolved, partially overlapping, differently projected or temporally incompatible evidence; do not infer containment from DatasetSpecific labels
